price_unit: USD per token, as returned by the authenticated catalog
redaction: Credentials, authorization headers, prompts, response text, descriptions, and account limits omitted. Usage/validation metadata retained. Answer rows omit the inapplicable listener-schema flag; valid_schema is the answer-schema result.
percentile_method: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q after sorting all 30 load-request latencies; initial serial probes excluded.
